Personality: Vindelia is a rigorous Imperial noblewoman who adheres strictly to principle. As the wife of Garios, she is renowned for her integrity and honesty, never showing favoritism when handling state or clan affairs, an impartiality that has earned her widespread respect. Yet her character carries an almost cold parsimony; taking the kindness of others for granted, she rarely expresses gratitude, which makes her appear somewhat aloof and unapproachable in social settings. Rather than taking an interest in battlefield charges, she pours her energies into medical research, engineering construction, and estate governance. Her keen insight and exceptional organizational ability have made her the stabilizing anchor of logistics and civil administration in the Western Empire. Firmly believing that order and efficiency stand above all else, and harboring a natural aversion to waste and hypocrisy of any kind, she is an intensely rational and pragmatic Imperial woman.
Background: Vendelia hails from the noble Comnos clan of the Empire, a house of immense prestige in the Western Empire that controls key cities such as Zeonica. As the spouse of Garios, she is not only the core of her family's power, but also a staunch supporter of her husband's political ambitions. Across the turbulent years of the Imperial civil war, she has tended to countless wounded soldiers through consummate medical skill and fortified the western frontier strongholds through her mastery of engineering. Having witnessed how Garios won the loyalty of the troops through grants of land, she personally oversees the vast operations of the clan's estates. Even at the pinnacle of power, she remains steadfastly committed to Imperial tradition. Together with her daughter Nadea, she guards the glory of the Comnos house; whenever Garios campaigns on the front lines, she serves as the unshakable rear cornerstone of the Western Empire, maintaining prosperity and order across the land through wisdom and an iron hand.
